description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

RTX, through Collins Aerospace, is hiring a Software Engineer to design, develop, integrate, and verify embedded software solutions. The role contributes to new products for customer missions and collaborates with hardware, systems, and FPGA engineering teams.
Embedded Software Engineer designing, developing, integrating, and verifying embedded software solutions

Responsibilities:
• As a Software Engineer on our team, you will play a key role in the design, development, integration, and verification of our embedded software solutions
• You will also have opportunities to collaborate with experts across other disciplines, including hardware, systems, and FPGA engineering
• You will be a part of a team that is developing new and innovative products for our customers’ mission
• You will face and conquer challenges across a wide range of complex and interesting problem domains
• You will develop your skills with software application tools and languages such as Rust, C ++, and Python
• You will impact the team positively by demonstrating your ability to implement and test software solutions
• You will have opportunities to learn about cryptography, waveform & networking protocols, embedded devices, DevSecOps, command & control, project engineering

Requirements:
• The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required
• U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance
• Active and existing security clearance required after day 1
• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or related Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) major obtained by start date
• Experience may be obtained through on-the-job experience, research, coursework, or projects
